Security & Privacy tutorial

ufw-docker on Omarchy

Closes the hole Docker punches through your firewall.

Package data synced 2026-10-28 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install ufw-docker on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add ufw-docker. It is a 24.9 KB download (67 KB installed), version 251123-2, licensed GPL License Version 3.0. To fix the Docker and UFW security flaw without disabling iptables. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install ufw-docker on Omarchy

By default, Docker writes its own iptables rules that bypass UFW, so a published container port can be reachable from the internet even though UFW looks like it's blocking it. ufw-docker patches UFW's rule files so container ports are only exposed the way you explicitly allow with normal `ufw route allow` commands, while still letting containers talk to each other internally.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add ufw-docker
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 251123-2:
    pacman -Qi ufw-docker

Open and use ufw-docker

ufw-docker has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql ufw-docker | grep /usr/bin/

ufw-docker requirements and compatibility

  • Docker and UFW already installed
  • Root/sudo access to edit /etc/ufw/after.rules

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • ufw
  • docker

Free and open source. License: GPL License Version 3.0.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install ufw-docker on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add ufw-docker. The download is 24.9 KB and it takes 67 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is ufw-docker free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL License Version 3.0.

How do I uninstall ufw-docker?

Run omarchy pkg drop ufw-docker. It removes the package from your system.

What does ufw-docker depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: ufw, docker. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is ufw-docker a desktop app?

No. ufw-docker has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is ufw-docker in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as ufw-docker (version 251123-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Chai Feng makes it. Project site: https://github.com/chaifeng/ufw-docker.
